w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: Back at the haven the argument starts: Bill is calling it "Old Gavel." The name's up for grabs — weigh in if you want.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE FOCUS GROUP! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (Buffering, The Callback, Murkcap, Ugly-Eyes) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (Buffering, The Callback, Murkcap, Ugly-Eyes) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something pads into the clearing — Ad Break. It's here.

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Editor.
firstContext: 💛 You hold Dispatcher's headset. You learned the voice — low, steady, unhurried. 'Panic is just information arriving too fast.' You hear it in your own voice now when it counts. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are still yours. The feast was the weapon.
Travel 1 tile to grove.
Something moves out there — The Editor.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.
👁️ Elena freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."

w5Mentions.name: The Timeslot
w5Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Timeslot is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
firstContext: 🍖 FEAST 📺 — Koray opens the pantry wide: 9× Foraged food, 1× Foraged food, 1× Foraged food. Bill, Hunter, Sofia, Elena eat until the fire burns low. Somebody tells the story again, the one everybody already knows. For one evening, hunger feels like a rumor. (−2,027 kcal from the pantry) The channe
🍖 FEASTED ×2.53 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Arc IV burns hotter. Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.

The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. The ground, getting a new address. Someone at the haven should hear about this.

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: Word will travel: Haven is turned away the hungry. Other fires will remember. (Opinion -4 with every village that knows you.)
🗣️ Hunter to Bill, by the fire: "The pantry's the thing. We don't raise The Granary on empty shelves — 13,829 of 20,000 kcal."
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
★ IDENTIFIED: Deadly Nightshade. A tall plant with purple bell flowers and shiny black cherry-like berries. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Oh! It has a NAME. You all love names.

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 7,4. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: 📓 Codex: you've SEEN Bird Whisperer now. Birds land on you. They also warn you: +20% chance to detect monsters before they detect you. (The birds see everything.)
🌪️ THE HERALD struck The Hungry Road in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)

📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 7,4. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
🌪️ THE FINALE fed in the night — 2,340 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
— DAY 81 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (13/10/6), with 4 wave-4 and 1 wave-5 fought, 4 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 12 · Craft 11 · Talk 12 · Explore 26 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Maya Hernandez ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,079 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
